additional_findings: All four ordinary reviews approved every final record; there were no semantic patches. They missed the API granularity errors and the baseline narrowed exception condition.
Revised pandoc marks the overridden Markdown instruction unresolved/no_runtime_effect. It does not assert a conflicting Markdown obligation, but its completeness status remains incomplete.
Each natural graph has one aggregate runtime function operation. This sample does not empirically exercise a many-operation task broadcast; that defect is isolated by the authored controls.
No repeated natural trial, new model comparison, autonomous candidate discovery or actual prompt edit occurred. The two fixed API probes are dependent questions within one task.
conclusion: Compiler boundary correction demonstrated; no overall automatic extraction winner or improved independent-factor availability demonstrated.
method: Read complete original system/user input, each emitted fact definition, direct bindings, structural guards, coverage and model review. No model approval used as reference truth.
